check_protobuf_implementation_type: call Type() to check which protobuf implementation is active in the current process
check_deterministic_serialization: call IsPythonDefaultSerializationDeterministic() to check if proto serialization is deterministic by default
map_api_version_to_impl: use _ApiVersionToImplementationType to map an api version number to its implementation type string
test_module_importability: use _CanImport to test whether a given module name can be imported successfully
review_implementation_selection_logic: review the module-level logic that selects between upb, cpp, and python protobuf implementations
